claims.claim: Infleqtion reported on September 24 that it achieved 30 entangled logical qubits using 80 physical qubits on Sqale, closing the prior factual unknown over whether the stated 2026 30-logical-qubit roadmap milestone had been reached, while not by itself proving customer economics or broad commercial quantum advantage.

The same SEC-furnished release explicitly keeps commercialization, market acceptance, quantum advantage, customer technical requirements, government relationships and the 100-logical-qubit 2028 roadmap as forward-looking risk-bearing outcomes; therefore the new technical milestone reduces technical execution uncertainty but does not erase commercialization or financing sensitivity.

risks.risk: The 30-logical-qubit milestone is technical validation, not evidence by itself of scalable customer economics, broad market acceptance or durable recurring revenue.
Roadmap progression to 100 logical qubits by 2028 and eventual quantum advantage remain forward-looking and exposed to implementation and market-acceptance risk.

contradictions.contradiction: A previously open 30-logical-qubit execution question is now answered by a current SEC-furnished milestone disclosure, while the broader economic-utility and commercialization questions remain open.
contradictions.disposition: partial resolution: technical milestone achieved; commercial/economic falsifiers remain active but are not present blockers by themselves

unknowns.unknown: Independent benchmark replication and customer workload economics for the 30-logical-qubit configuration remain unverified in the current evidence set.
Whether the milestone materially accelerates contracted commercial usage or reduces future external-capital needs remains Alpha-owned underwriting work.

lineage.reason: new primary SEC-furnished evidence resolves the prior 30-logical-qubit milestone unknown while preserving successor commercialization/economic-utility uncertainty
